AN ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING ELECTION PROCEDURES FOR THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN

BE If ORDAINED, by the Mayor and Town Council of the Town of Pine

Mountain, Georgia, and it is hereby ordained, by the authority of the same as follows:

SECTION I: DATE OF ELECTIONS A. The general municipal elections shall be held biennially on the Tuesday next following the first Monday in November; B. Special elections shall be held in odd numbered years only on 1. The third Tuesday in March; 2. The third Tuesday in June; 3. The third Tuesday in September; or 4. The Tuesday after the first Monday in November. Cc. Special elections shall be held in even numbered years only on 1. The date of the general primary; Z. The third Tuesday in September; or 3. The Tuesday after the first Monday in November. D. The provisions of this Section shali not apply in the event of a recall election or to fill a vacancy of office.
1:
Every candidate for nunicipal office who files a notice of candidacy shall meet the constitutional and statutory qualifications for holding the office being sought.

SECTION III: NOTICE OF CANDIDACY A. Each candidate shall file notice of candidacy in the office of the municipal election superintendent at least 22 but not more than 52 days prior to the election. B. The next succeeding day may be substituted for Saturday, Sunday, or holiday as last day to exercise any priviledge. Cc. Each candidate shall accompany his notice of candidacy with an affidavit stating: 1. His residence, with street number, if any, and his post office address; 2. His profession, business, or occupation, if any; 3. That he is an elector of the municipality and is eligible to vote in the election in which he is a candidate; The name of the office which he is seeking; That he is eligible to hold such office; That he has never been convicted and sentenced in any court of competent jurisdiction for fraudulent violation of primary or election laws, malfeasance in office, or felony involving moral turpitude under the laws of this state or any other state of the United States, or that his civil rights have been restored; and ?. That he will not knowingly violate any provision of this ordinance or any rules and requilations adopted by the governing authority of the Town of mo

Pine Mountain.
3:
This ordinance shail take effect from and after the date of its passage and ratification by the Mayor and Town Council of the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia.

James V Edgar, Mayor Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia
